title: Frontierra Clicker — an idle RPG where your party determines its team attack
author: wizzone
selftext:
I'm building Frontierra Clicker, a fantasy idle/clicker RPG about putting together a party of three heroes. Your party fights automatically, and clicking adds extra damage. The lineup determines your Party Art, a shared attack that changes with your team composition.

The core game is playable, with branching jobs, equipment refinement, companions and bosses across five regions. I'm now balancing progression and polishing the playtest and demo. The Steam page is live, but the demo isn't public yet.

I'm using Codex for coding and testing, and image generation for the characters and environments. A lot of the work has been keeping those assets consistent across job upgrades, fitting them into the UI, and testing how everything feels together in-game.

[Frontierra Clicker on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5495590/Frontierra_Clicker/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_trailer)
